Fix round OR-112-19 (client purchases secret) — head 32f7ede45e065175b04c228732e32382006057f9 (B-SECRETS-2, agent 112, builder)

**Mobile grep first** (growth-project-mobile origin/main f34b5b99, `git grep` over src/): no code reads a client secret, ephemeral key or any `*_secret` from a purchase row. `ClientPurchase` (`src/api/clientPaymentsApi.ts`) types only `id, package_id, status, entitlement_active, access_expires_at, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, created_at`; `getPurchases` / `getPaymentStatus` / `PurchaseUnpackScreen.buildReceipt` read only those. Client secrets are read only from mint responses (`POST /v1/checkout/sessions` in `PackageSelectionSheet.tsx`; `CheckoutSessionResponse` in `packagesApi.ts`). Mobile does not call `GET /v1/coach/purchases`. There is no client `GET /v1/checkout/purchases/:id`.

**Ruling applied:** mobile never reads it, so the secret is dropped from the client purchase list for every status (including a purchase still awaiting client action). A payment that needs client action resumes through `POST /v1/checkout/payment-intent` with the same idempotency key, which replays the cached secret to its owner only (unchanged).

**What changed (32f7ede4)**
- `src/checkout/client-purchases.select.ts` (new): `CLIENT_PURCHASE_SELECT` explicit allow-list + `ClientPurchaseView`. Keeps every mobile-read field plus amount, currency, billing_type, last_error, source, client/coach ids, updated_at. Drops `stripe_client_secret`, `stripe_ephemeral_key`, `idempotency_key`, `stripe_checkout_session_id`, `stripe_payment_intent_id`, `stripe_subscription_id`, `stripe_customer_id`, `stripe_destination_account`, `grant_metadata`, `landing_page_id`, `contract_envelope_id`.
- `CheckoutService.listForClient` (`GET /v1/checkout/purchases`) selects it.
- Found while checking: `CheckoutService.listForCoach` (`GET /v1/coach/purchases`, `CoachPurchasesController`) returned raw rows to coaches, the same C-641-2 leak this PR closes on `/v1/coach/payments`. It now selects `COACH_PURCHASE_SELECT` (`CoachPurchaseView` exported).
- Other client purchase reads checked, already shaped: `/purchases/:id/drops` (select `{ id }`), `/sessions/:id/confirm`, `claim-free` / `claim-grant`, public thank-you page.

**Failing-before evidence:** `test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts` drives the real `CheckoutController.listPurchases` and `CoachPurchasesController.list` over the real `CheckoutService` with a Prisma double that returns the full stored row when no `select` is given. On ea919f6b (spec + new select file, service unchanged): 3 failed / 3 passed — the client list, client pagination and coach feed responses contained `stripe_client_secret: "pi_3SETTLED_secret_..."`, `stripe_ephemeral_key`, `idempotency_key`, Stripe ids and grant metadata. After 32f7ede4: 6/6 pass.

**Local (targeted, through heavy.sh):** `npx jest --runInBand test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts test/checkout.service.spec.ts test/checkout-buyer-drops.spec.ts test/payment-ops.controller.spec.ts test/packages.service.spec.ts test/dunning-v2-lockout-allowlist-route-table.spec.ts` → 7 suites, 207 tests passed. Scoped strict `tsc --noEmit` over the touched files: clean. eslint on changed files: clean. `node scripts/check-r75.js --mode=staged`: no positive token change. Prettier clean on new files (the pre-existing format drift in checkout.service.ts is untouched).

PR body updated (tier T4 unchanged, fix-round row added) and retitled. Main not merged (PR is MERGEABLE). Needs an independent audit at this head.
